description: Design scenarios run against the toolkit; see scripts/scenario_lib.py for what each kind of check means.

gaps.Layout / separation distances: Table-based inter-unit spacing is not implemented (OISD-STD-118 and company spacing tables were not read). Consequence-based distances are covered through FIR-01 to FIR-03 (pool-fire and flame-flux), FIR-08 (plume), REG-05 (RMP) and QRA-02 (emergency planning).
gaps.F&G detector mapping: 3D detector geometry is not implemented; the 2D coverage optimiser is exercised by WRK-05 under 'Fire & gas mapping'.
gaps.Gas suppression / clean-agent room desig: Not implemented: the standards were not read and the manufacturer's calculation governs.
gaps.Load flow, harmonics, transient stabilit: Not implemented: these are software studies, not hand calculations; the toolkit covers the hand-calculation forms (ELE-08 to ELE-13).
gaps.Pulsation and vibration studies: Not implemented: needs acoustic and structural dynamic models that were not built.
